title: Translucent Entities
description: Replaces all Entity Rendertypes with Translucency
body:
# Translucent Entities
This mod replaces the Rendertypes of all entities from Solid and Cutout to Translucent. This allows you to make simple semitransparent textures for all mobs for your resourcepacks! This effect can also be achieved with ETF .properties files, but I didn't realize it until I made this mod.
<hr>

![A Creeper ghost created using a resourcepack and this mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/OwazPN6T/images/ba61c7a7c0acf84ff0fcf5e5f333ddb14504139a.jpeg)
<hr>

If you encounter any bugs with specific mobs or you want to request something, please join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/C9Q6XFG8T8)!
